reasons.plausibility: Local lattice distortion as a strengthening mechanism is well-established for multi-element alloys, though other factors (e.g., ordering) may contribute.
reasons.testability: They propose systematic composition variations, direct lattice distortion measurements, and mechanical tests that can decisively link distortion to strength.
reasons.usefulness: It provides a clear, comparative framework for isolating the effect of size mismatch in multi-component alloys.
